name: Advanced Quantum Optics and Applications
description: Review of quantum states of light, generation and detection of quantum light, quantum light by non-linear optical processes, squeezed states of light and their applications, quantum tomography, landmark experiments in quantum optics, light-matter interaction, basics of quantum computing, quantum sensing and quantum imaging, quantum microscopy, quantum memories and repeater, experimental quantum communications: quantum cryptography, quantum teleportation, entanglement swapping.
